text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That takes care of the shopping, then. 
—Well, let us be off.

While out shopping with Calstone Light O, 
she suddenly sprinted off, clutching a 
lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... Could you wait just a moment? 
Let me finish going over the prizes—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're presenting the contract 
terms. My father told me this is extremely 
important. Please, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: H-Hello... *ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Please!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes... That's one lottery ticket, 
right? Alright, go ahead and draw once.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'll turn it at top speed. Haaaaaaah!

Calstone Light O eagerly spun the raffle 
wheel lever!
And the result was—
(RATTLE-CLATTER-RATTLE-CLATTER-CLATTER-CLATTER!)

Spun far too fast, the lottery machine 
kept spinning with no sign of stopping...
choice_data_list:
Ah, um... is it okay if I stop it with my 
hands?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Please do. It happens from time to time— 
an Umamusume turning it with all her 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Then with my own hands. Hah!

Calstone Light O strikes the raffle wheel 
with a chop. The result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Did I do it!? I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, a hot springs trip! It's a hot 
springs vacation voucher!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And according to what I saw on my phone 
earlier about this hot spring town—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it very easy to get there? It's so 
accessible, which is wonderful.

"According to my memory, it should be a 
place that takes several train transfers 
to reach, but—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Look, do it like this—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the map, it's completely 
straight.

Actual travel isn't as simple as it looks 
on a map. When I explained that transfers 
would be required...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. However, Trainer, there is an 
intriguing entry here.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Direct bus service scheduled to open next 
spring, huh.

If that's the case, it will undoubtedly be 
the fastest route. We'd better wait for it 
to open.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer, let's save this 
voucher for next spring. I can't wait.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A direct bus...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Nothing will stop us from heading straight 
for that hot spring! Nothing at all...!

Picturing the ultimate trip, Calstone 
Light O's excitement launched straight 
into the stratosphere.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you've won something quite nice, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This shape, pierced by a carrot... It 
reminds me of a legend I once heard from 
Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thrust into the shore of a certain lake— 
was a single holy sword.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Only the true hero can pull it out. The 
way this carrot is lodged in the ground is 
an exact match."

If Calstone Light O manages to pull it 
out, that would mean—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's just a legend, though. Let's 
head back quickly and eat.
choice_data_list: Wait, you're not pulling it out?
Huh, you're not going to pull it out?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I will not draw it. Think about it. If the 
Hero can draw it—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think even heavy machinery 
could pull it right out? Besides..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"If you pull out what they went through 
the trouble of skewering, it won't taste 
as good, right? Let's eat it straight off 
the stick."

Perfected gourmet food has no need for 
romance. Together with Calstone Light O, I 
enjoyed a delicious meal.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's a massive haul, a massive 
haul. Seeing this sheer volume makes my 
heart race.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
And furthermore, this carrot... is no 
ordinary carrot.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes, please take a close look at the box.
This is what was written there:
“Direct from the farm”!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Direct from the farm. Do you understand 
what that means, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
No, nothing comes to mind right off the 
bat, but...

No, nothing comes to mind right away, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it means this: It was sent 
directly from the producer!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, we can't afford to waste 
time dawdling either."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's deliver it swiftly from its place of 
origin straight to our bellies.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Swish! Swish!

While munching through a massive pile of 
carrots, Calstone Light O kept going 
"shoo-shoo!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose that's how it goes. Life 
is neither lucky nor unlucky, but 
rather...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like my results keep coming out 
just a little below average.
choice_data_list: I think I kinda get how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
One carrot. If there's anything I can do 
with this, it would be—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer. Do you know the Carrot Game?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: All right, both of you face each other...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Each of them keeps eating the carrot from 
opposite ends. And when they do...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Do you know what will happen in the end?

It was a forbidden question. If you keep 
eating until the very end, naturally...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: They will be gone: the carrots.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: And what's more—at twice the speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Does that mean if four people eat it, 
we can finish it four times as fast?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Shall I call them? Believe and Durandal 
as well."
choice_data_list:
No, you should eat it alone. It's better 
that way.

No, you eat it yourself. It's better that 
way.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see. Well then...

"Summoning someone would only trouble 
them. Calstone Light O silently munched on 
her carrots alone."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, as for this result... It might 
sound a bit roundabout, but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A total miss, isn't it?
choice_data_list: It's not spinning, not at all!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll give these tissues to 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes, the reason being—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I don't need it.
choice_data_list: It's all in how you say it...

text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's spirits plummeted 
straight down in a steep dive.
